slides.cap: Each Sheet runs a Google script as the login that deployed it. When that login closes the script stops, and nothing that failed in the gap is sent again.

steps.title: In ERC Content Desk on the shared drive
items: erc-content-desk, in Content queue. Without it the queue's Sheet copy, new send dates, the scraper's files, Publish's copy in Drive and Research briefs stop.
subscribe to listserve, in Listserv. Without it sign-ups and the Listserv page's count stop.
steps.links: erc-content-desk subscribe to listserve

slides.cap: Do this in each Sheet. Each gets a new address, and the desk uses it once its owner sets it.

notes.html: In erc-content-desk, leave Script properties alone: the desk's token and folder ids live there.

steps.title: For each Sheet
items: Deploy, New deployment. Pick Web app from the gear.
Execute as: Me. Who has access: Anyone. Then Deploy.
Allow the permissions. If Google says unverified, choose Advanced, then Go to the project.
Copy the Web app URL, ending in /exec. Email it to the desk's owner (Who to ask) and say which Sheet.

slides.cap: Once the owner says the new addresses are in, check each script.

steps.title: erc-content-desk
items: On Submit content, send a test item with Add to the queue.
Within a minute it is the last row on the Sheet's first tab.

slides.cap: If a check fails, a message names the Sheet's script, or a menu is missing.

steps.title: A check fails, or "Sheet API returned HTTP"
items: In Deploy, Manage deployments, check Who has access reads Anyone.
Send the newest Web app URL to the desk's owner again.

steps.title: "Unknown action" or "does not know this action yet"
items: Paste apps-script/Code.gs from the desk's code over the script in erc-content-desk, then save.
Deploy, Manage deployments, the pencil, Version: New version, then Deploy. The address stays the same.
steps.links: Code.gs on GitHub

steps.title: No Extensions menu
items: You need edit access to the Sheet. Ask for it, then start again.
